test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**the only**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**The only**" is the correct phrase to use to indicate exclusivity.
 
• "**The**" is a definite article in English, and it is used before nouns to specify or identify a particular person, place, thing, or concept that is already known to the speaker and the listener or is clear from the context. 
 
• "**Only**" means exclusive or sole, indicating that there is no other or none but the specified person, thing, or group.
 
• It is grammatically correct to use "**the only**" before a noun, as in "the only option".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**That only**", is grammatically incorrect as it does not use the correct article before the noun.
 
• "**The alone**", is grammatically incorrect as "alone" is an adjective and cannot be used as a noun.
 
• "**That individual**", does not convey the same meaning as "the only" and is therefore incorrect.
